Summarize a posterior for safety signal detection as a data frame

Source: R/summary.bssd_post.R
summary.bssd_post.Rd

Summarize a posterior for safety signal detection as a data frame

Usage

# S3 method for class 'bssd_post'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class bssd_post.

...

Not used.

Value

A data frame with one row and the columns model, prob, signal, rr_mean, rr_median, rr_lower, rr_upper, ip_placebo, ip_drug, ip_difference and error. The incidence columns are NA when t_star was not given.

See also

bdribs_post, expbern_post, llbern_post

Examples

fit <- bdribs_post(y = 5, exposure = 500, k = 2, lambda_hp = 18 / 4000,
                   pt_hp = 4000, t_star = 1)
summary(fit)
#>    model     prob signal  rr_mean rr_median  rr_lower rr_upper  ip_placebo
#> 1 BDRIBS 0.819888  FALSE 2.450603  2.123375 0.1950283 6.588037 0.004655827
#>      ip_drug ip_difference error
#> 1 0.01058191   0.005926085    NA
